description_en: Updates a specified push rule by overwriting the existing configuration. If you add a new rule item, ensure that the original rule items are also included. Otherwise, the original items are overwritten by the new content
description_zh: 更新指定的推送规则，更新方式为覆盖式更新，若是新增规则项，需要确保原有的也存在，否则会被新内容覆盖
name: UpdatePushRule

parameters.help_en: The organization ID in string format. You can obtain the ID from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) for temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。 
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

fields.help_en:
The rule name. Valid values:

CommitMessageChecker: Commit message rule.
CommitAuthorEmailChecker: Commit email rule.
CommitAuthorChecker: Commit author check.
CommitCommitterChecker: Committer check.
ForcePushChecker: Force push prevention check.
CommitFilesChecker: Commit file restriction rule
fields.help_zh:
规则名称，可选值：

CommitMessageChecker：提交说明规则
CommitAuthorEmailChecker：提交邮箱规则
CommitAuthorChecker：提交作者检查
CommitCommitterChecker：提交人检查
ForcePushChecker：禁止强制推送检查
CommitFilesChecker：提交文件限制规则
fields.name: checker_name

fields.help_en:
The restriction level for code owner checks. This parameter is valid only for the author check and committer check rules. You do not need to specify this parameter for other rules. Valid values:
warn: Issues a warning only and allows the push.
block: Blocks the push
fields.help_zh:
该字段作用于代码属主检查下的限制级别设置，仅检查作者和检查提交者有效，其他规则可不传值，可选值：
warn：仅警告，允许推送
block：禁止推送
fields.name: checker_type

fields.help_en:
The extra message. This parameter is valid for commit message, commit email, author check, committer check, and force push prevention rules:
For the commit message rule, set extraMessage to the regular expression used for checking.
For the commit email rule, set extraMessage to the regular expression used for checking emails.
For the force push prevention rule, set extraMessage to "disabled".
For the author check rule, set extraMessage to "on". Leave this parameter empty if the check is not required.
For the committer check rule, set extraMessage to "on". Leave this parameter empty if the check is not required
fields.help_zh:
在提交说明、提交邮箱、检查作者、检查提交人以及禁止强制推送时有效：
提交说明规则，extraMessage传入检查的正则表达式
提交邮箱规则，extraMessage传入检查的邮箱正则表示
禁止强制推送，extraMessage传入 "disabled"
检查作者规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
检查提交人规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
fields.name: extra_message

fields.help_en: The regular expressions for commit file restrictions. This parameter is valid only for the commit file restriction rule. You can specify multiple regular expressions
fields.help_zh: 该字段仅作用于提交文件限制，传入正则表达式，支持多条正则限制
fields.name: file_rule_regexes
